mapper.insert: insert into batch.replay_operation ( tenant_id, operation_key, operation_type, status, calendar_code, from_date, through_date, scope, execution_mode, candidate_source, scope_payload, result_policy, config_version_policy, config_version, source_workflow_run_id, source_workflow_node_run_id, source_job_instance_id, target_request_id, target_workflow_run_id, request_hash, snapshot_hash, snapshot_payload, reason, requested_by, approved_by, total_count, succeeded_count, failed_count, in_flight_count, started_at, completed_at, trace_id, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{operationKey}::uuid, #{operationType}, #{status}, #{calendarCode}, #{fromDate}, #{throughDate}, #{scope}, #{executionMode}, #{candidateSource}, #{scopePayload,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb, #{resultPolicy}, #{configVersionPolicy}, #{configVersion}, #{sourceWorkflowRunId}, #{sourceWorkflowNodeRunId}, #{sourceJobInstanceId}, #{targetRequestId}, #{targetWorkflowRunId}, #{requestHash}, #{snapshotHash}, #{snapshotPayload,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb, #{reason}, #{requestedBy}, #{approvedBy}, #{totalCount}, #{succeededCount}, #{failedCount}, #{inFlightCount}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{traceId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )

mapper.update: update batch.replay_operation set status = #{status}, total_count = #{totalCount}, succeeded_count = #{succeededCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, in_flight_count = #{inFlightCount}, approved_by = coalesce(#{approvedBy}, approved_by), started_at = coalesce(#{startedAt}, started_at), completed_at = coalesce(#{completedAt}, completed_at), updated_at = #{now} where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{id}

update batch.replay_operation operation set total_count = aggregate.total_count, succeeded_count = aggregate.succeeded_count, failed_count = aggregate.failed_count, in_flight_count = aggregate.in_flight_count, status = aggregate.operation_status, started_at = case when aggregate.has_running then coalesce(operation.started_at, #{now}) else operation.started_at end, completed_at = case when aggregate.in_flight_count = 0 then coalesce(operation.completed_at, #{now}) else null end, updated_at = #{now} from ( select child.tenant_id, child.replay_operation_id, count(*)::int as total_count, count(*) filter (where child.status = 'SUCCEEDED')::int as succeeded_count, count(*) filter (where child.status in ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL_FAILED'))::int as failed_count, count(*) filter (where child.status in ('PENDING_APPROVAL', 'RUNNING'))::int as in_flight_count, bool_or(child.status = 'RUNNING') as has_running, case when bool_or(child.status = 'RUNNING') then 'RUNNING' when bool_or(child.status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL') then 'PENDING_APPROVAL' when bool_or(child.status = 'CANCELLED') and bool_or(child.status in ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'PARTIAL_FAILED')) then 'PARTIAL_FAILED' when bool_or(child.status = 'CANCELLED') then 'CANCELLED' when count(*) filter (where child.status in ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL_FAILED')) > 0 and count(*) filter (where child.status = 'SUCCEEDED') > 0 then 'PARTIAL_FAILED' when count(*) filter (where child.status in ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL_FAILED')) > 0 then 'FAILED' else 'SUCCEEDED' end as operation_status from batch.batch_day_replay_session child where child.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and child.replay_operation_id = #{operationId} group by child.tenant_id, child.replay_operation_id ) aggregate where operation.tenant_id = aggregate.tenant_id and operation.id = aggregate.replay_operation_id
